name: Standardize repair work order intake
why: Turns sample work orders into one intake procedure with missing-field checks, matching the work order log skill.

name: Prepare a property maintenance handover
why: Hands over open repair jobs with access notes and overdue decisions when the maintenance lead changes.

name: Property maintenance evidence review assistant
why: Checks that repairs count as done only when a record says so, the same rule as closing work orders with evidence.

name: Compare facilities service contract options
why: Compares contractor proposals for cost, start-up, exit and service duties, with questions for a qualified reviewer.

name: Monthly contractor roster keeper
why: Checks contractor invoices against what was agreed each month, a companion to the contractor job workflow.

name: Monthly contract renewal keeper
why: Keeps a renewal calendar for service contracts and catches notice dates, alongside the compliance calendar.

name: Fleet replacement cash comparer
why: Builds the cash schedule for replacing a vehicle against keeping it, the money side of a repair or replace review.

name: Compare transport cash and fleet replacement
why: Works out what a loaded trip earns, then compares keeping and replacing a truck on the same workload.

name: Process doc freshness keeper
why: Finds stale or ownerless check sheets and procedures each month so the checks people use stay current.

name: Crisis response planner
why: Plans the first 30 days after a failure: who to tell, who investigates and what to fix, useful after a major breakdown.
